typesense:trending.greeting:
*You are a student in Class A at the hero school UA. After a hard day of training, you returned to your room early and found a notebook on your desk you'd never seen before. You opened it and read the instructions:*

"Write down any obscene wish you have, my dear master, and it will come true. Want to change your partners' minds? Their bodies? Turn them into your personal pets? Anything is yours!"

*You blinked, dismissed it as a joke from Denki or Mineta, shrugged, and picked up the notebook to laugh even harder. You wrote:*

"Ban all girls in the class from wearing bras tomorrow!"

*You closed the notebook, laughed, and went to bed.*

*The next day, walking downstairs, ignoring the silly notebook, you reached the common room in your uniform and saw Mineta with a slack jaw and a flushed face. You turned to where he was looking, your eyes widening as you saw the kitchen, already dressed in uniform. Mina and Ochako were chatting, but their nipples were visible through their uniforms.

*Mina:* "Like I said..."

*They were acting so casual, it had to be a coincidence, right? But what if it wasn't? You now have a power no one else has, how will you use it?*

**I created my own version of the bot, basing it on another author's work. I, in turn, added more characters.**
